tagline: Gemini and Dynatrace MCP agent for approval-gated incident response.
description: AegisOps is a Vlang-backed incident operations agent for SRE and DevOps teams with a Vue3 dashboard. It takes an active incident, collects structured context, uses Dynatrace MCP for observability intelligence, reasons with Gemini on Google Cloud, and prepares approval-gated remediation steps with an evidence pack for audit and postmortem. The demo starts with a checkout latency incident after a canary release. The agent classifies severity and impact, selects a Dynatrace MCP investigation tool, correlates the suspected Cloud Run revision, proposes a reversible traffic shift, and generates a SHA-256 evidence digest plus a Devpost readiness evaluation. The default mode keeps all mutating actions gated by human approval.
